storyCards.headline: It's Up To You: The Breakthrough Moment
storyCards.fact:
Rick Nelson's "It's Up To You" reached #6 on the Billboard Hot 100. "It's Up to You" is a song written by Jerry Fuller and performed by Rick Nelson.

The song peaked at #6 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 12 weeks on the chart.

It's Up To You was released in 1962.
